home.title: Tank's | Automatic Vehicle-Washing Machines
home.description: Tank's builds automatic vehicle-washing machines. Meet Tank's tiny, a compact, contactless 360° gantry wash that cleans consistently in around three minutes.
home.imageAlt: Render of Tank's tiny compact single-arm gantry car-wash machine.

tiny.title: Tank's tiny | Contactless Automatic Car Wash
tiny.description: Tank's tiny is a compact single-arm gantry wash with automatic, contactless 360° water and foam coverage. A complete wash cycle takes around three minutes.
tiny.imageAlt: Render of Tank's tiny compact single-arm gantry car-wash machine.
